breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 跨生理屏障递送与 RNA / 蛋白稳态重塑
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把药真正送进大脑、心脏与深层致密病灶
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 神经退行性疾病（渐冻症 ALS、阿尔茨海默病、帕金森）、胶质母细胞瘤与纤维化器官病往往不是没发现靶点，而是大分子药进不去血脑屏障，或普通小分子误伤全身。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 突破跨血脑屏障转运体载体、GalNAc-siRNA / ASO 精密肝脏与中枢基因沉默调控、靶向蛋白降解嵌合体（PROTAC）及虚拟细胞药效预测技术。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 可穿屏障肽/纳米载体生成式设计、RNA 序列稳定与毒性预测、多组学虚拟细胞扰动响应仿真。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 高致死实体瘤微环境破壁与普惠早筛

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”

aliases_zh: 非囊性纤维化支气管扩张症 (NCFB)
curated.category: 慢性呼吸系统疾病 (Chronic Respiratory Disease)
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 支气管壁肌肉及弹性组织破坏导致不可逆柱状/囊状扩张、黏液清除障碍与慢性绿脓杆菌等定植感染恶性循环；长期演变为慢性呼吸衰竭、肺心病，队列4–5年全因死亡率可达16%–25%；最凶险的急性致死急症为“支气管扩张突发大咯血”，可数分钟内窒息死亡。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 不可逆肺结构改变无法单纯服药逆转，但坚持气道廓清排痰、高发作风险人群低剂量长程大环内酯类抗炎、急性期针对铜绿假单胞菌强效抗感染及局部支扩肺叶切除可有效长期控病；2025年全球终于迎来首款获批特异性靶向中性粒细胞炎症的非囊性纤维化支扩新药Brensocatib。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO全球死因未单列支气管扩张症。全球发病/患病率在各地区约50–1,200+/10万不等，欧亚队列显示确诊患者4–5年全因死亡率高达16%–25%。

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国尚无全国性单列死亡总数，但属于呼吸科第三大慢性气道疾病；既往大样本流行病学调查显示≥40岁人群医师诊断支扩患病率约1.2%（实际受既往肺结核及幼年肺炎后遗影响真实患病率更高）。

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球老龄化及CT筛查后病例诊断持续攀升，欧美患病率近二十年倍增。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国40岁以上城市人口自我报告医师确诊率即达约1.2%，因既往结核及儿童下呼吸道感染史多发，是我国负担最沉重的“被忽视慢性肺病”之一。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 遇支气管扩张突发大咯血（单次≥100 mL或反复窒息风险）即刻患侧卧位、严格禁止盲目使用强镇咳药抑制排血引发血块窒息、即刻建立静脉通路予垂体后叶素/特利加压素收缩支气管动脉（监控血压冠脉），持续大咯血第一时间转介行“支气管动脉栓塞术（BAE）”急诊封堵；感染急性加重咳浓痰发热及时行痰培养（覆盖铜绿假单胞菌），静滴抗假单胞菌β-内酰胺（如头孢他啶/哌拉西林他唑巴坦/美罗培南）或氟喹诺酮14天。

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 长期“无药可用”局面于2025年历史性改写：全球首个口服可逆DPP-1抑制剂布伦索卡替（Brensocatib / Brinsupri）凭借大规模III期ASPEN试验显著降低年急性加重率约20%，于2025年8月获美国FDA正式批准成为首个NCFB获批新药；此外多种雾化吸入抗铜绿假单胞菌抗生素（如吸入妥布霉素国内上市/试验推进）及新兴组织蛋白酶C/中性粒细胞抑制剂同步处在II–III期临床队列。

master.definition_en: A neoplasm of follicle center B cells which has at least a partial follicular pattern. Follicular lymphomas comprise about 35% of adult non-Hodgkin lymphomas in the U.S. and 22% worldwide. Most patients have widespread disease at diagnosis. Morphologically, follicular lymphomas are classified as Grade 1, Grade 2, and Grade 3, depending on the percentage of the large lymphocytes present. The vast majority of cases (70-95%) express the BCL-2 rearrangement [t(14;18)]. Histological grade correlates with prognosis. master.definition_en: Larsen-like syndrome, B3GAT3 type is a rare, genetic, primary bone dysplasia characterized by laxity, dislocations and contractures of the joints, short stature, foot deformities (e.g. clubfeet), broad tips of fingers and toes, short neck, dysmorphic facial features (hypertelorism, downslanting palpebral fissures, upturned nose with anteverted nares, high arched palate) and various cardiac malformations. Severe disease is associated with multiple fractures, osteopenia, arachnodactyly and blue sclerae. A broad spectrum of additional features, including scoliosis, radio-ulnar synostosis, mild developmental delay, and various eye disorders (glaucoma, amblyopia, hyperopia, astigmatism, ptosis), are also reported.

master.name_en: Acrodysplasia with ossification abnormalities, short stature, and fibular hypoplasia
master.definition_en: A hereditary disorder characterized by disproportionate short stature, a relatively large head, and a long triangular face early in life. This phenotype later evolves to one with in which the head is relatively small, the mandible is large and pointy. The affected individuals have normal cognitive abilities and lack any neurological deficits. Other typical features include a prominent nose, a voice with an unusual high-pitched sound, relatively small ears, curved digits (clinodactyly), short bones in fingers and toes (brachydactyly), small hands, underdeveloped (hypoplastic) fingernails, a waddling gait, and sparse hair post-pubertally.
synonyms_en: acrodysplasia with ossification abnormalities, short stature and fibular hypoplasia

master.name_en: autosomal recessive cerebellar ataxia-saccadic intrusion syndrome
master.definition_en: Autosomal recessive cerebellar ataxia-saccadic intrusion syndrome is a rare hereditary ataxia characterized by a progressive cerebellar ataxia associated with disruption of visual fixation by saccadic intrusions (overshooting horizontal saccades with macrosaccadic oscillations and increased velocity of larger saccades). It presents with progressive gait, trunk and limb ataxia with pyramidal tract signs (increased tendon reflexes and Babinski sign), myoclonic jerks, fasciculations, cerebellar dysarthria, sensorimotor axonal neuropathy with impaired joint position, vibration, temperature, pain sensations, pes cavus, and saccadic intrusions with characteristic overshooting horizontal saccades, macrosaccadic oscillations, and increased velocity of larger saccades, without other eye movement disturbances.

master.definition_en: A progressive muscular dystrophy characterized by co-existence of limb-girdle weakness and diffuse joint contractures without cardiomyopathy. breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。

master.definition_en: A varicose disease that involves the mesentery.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。

master.definition_en: Chester porphyria is a unique type of porphyria with the signs and symptoms of acute intermittent porphyria (AIP) and the biochemical defects of both AIP and variegate porphyria (VP). Chester porphyria does not conform to any of the recognized types of acute porphyria. The symptoms associated with Chester porphyria are similar to those observed in other acute porphyrias. Treatment is symptomatic.

breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。

master.definition_en: A rare cardiac condition characterized by acute severe right ventricular failure with subsequent hemodynamic instability following a cardiac surgical procedure. Predisposing factors include suboptimal myocardial protection during surgery, long cardiopulmonary bypass time, right ventricular myocardial ischemia or infarction, atrial arrhythmias, reperfusion lung injury with secondary pulmonary hypertension, post-operative pulmonary micro- or macro-embolism, and pre-existing pulmonary vascular disease, among others.
